steps: Start service.save using synthetic account and valid selection.
Hold the store just before invoking its trusted encrypt callback.
Call service.close while operation is waiting.
Release the store and invoke real callback; observe returned DTO and decrypt captured envelope.
shutdownOrdering: server/lifecycle.mjs lines46 and58 closes diagnostics before request drain; index diagnostics closes preferences service.
impact: An already admitted write resuming encryption after shutdown can persist an envelope encrypted under an all-zero key. After restart the configured key cannot decrypt it.
